headline: This law extends the National Flood Insurance Program's authority through November 30, 2018.
what_it_does: The National Flood Insurance Program lets property owners buy federally backed flood insurance. Without a new law, the program's legal authority would have run out, so this act reauthorizes it. The extension runs only through November 30, 2018, which makes it a short-term fix rather than a long-term change. The summary does not describe any other changes to coverage, premiums, or rules.

who_it_affects.group: Property owners in flood-prone areas who hold or buy flood insurance through the program
who_it_affects.how: Their ability to buy or renew federally backed flood coverage continues without a lapse while the extension is in effect.

who_it_affects.group: Lenders and communities that participate in the National Flood Insurance Program
who_it_affects.how: Mortgage and floodplain rules tied to the program remain in place through the extended deadline.

when_it_takes_effect: The extension took effect when the act was enacted on July 31, 2018, and runs through November 30, 2018.
